animations.name: medium kick v2
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One crisp medium kick from standing guard to full extension. Shift weight onto the planted supporting foot, lean the torso back, chamber the knee, and snap a sharp diagonal mid-high kick upward-right into the exact final pose with the rear fist pulled back behind the hip and the front fist raised near chest level. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the supporting foot anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
